international.title: Apec summit live: Xi and Putin start talks; Rubio says Trump serious about meeting Kim Jong-un
international.summary: Summit in Chinese tech hub Shenzhen set to include highly anticipated meeting between Xi, Trump and Putin Shenzhen takes centre stage as Xi sends ‘Chinamaxxing’ message at Apec summit What is Apec? Explained in 30 seconds Speaking to the press in Manila, US secretary of state Marco Rubio has addressed speculation that North Korean leader Kim Jong-un will attend the Apec summit . Asked how serious the idea was, Rubio said: It’s serious in the sense that I think the President has never viewed meeting and talking to someone as a concession. He has often made the case – and I think rightfully so – that how are you going to solve problems with people you have disagreements with if you don’t speak to them, if you’re not willing to engage with them. I think there’s been this conventional thought in American foreign policy that if you meet with someone, you give them credibility; if you meet with someone, you somehow are saying that everything they’re doing is good or right. And that’s not the way the President views it, and I’m glad he doesn’t view it that way. Continue reading...
